books.title: Lila and the Moonlit Pony
books.subtitle: A meadow bedtime story
books.blurb: Lila follows shy hooves into the moonlight to find a cream pony and a lost silver bell.

titles.fr: Lila et le poney au clair de lune
titles.es: Lila y el poni de luna
titles.ja: ライラと つきのひかりの ポニー
titles.zh: 莉拉和月光小马

blurbs.fr: Lila suit de petits sabots timides dans le clair de lune pour trouver un poney crème et une clochette d'argent perdue.
blurbs.es: Lila sigue unos cascos tímidos bajo la luna para encontrar un poni de crema y una campanita de plata perdida.
blurbs.ja: ライラは お月さまの したで、はずかしがりやの ひづめの おとを たどり、クリームいろの ポニーと なくした ぎんの すずを みつけます。
blurbs.zh: 莉拉跟着月光下害羞的马蹄声，去找一匹奶油色的小马和一只丢失的银铃。

books.title: Elon and the Physics of Wonder
books.subtitle: Ask why, then try
books.blurb: Olivia visits a sunny workshop, where Elon turns falling apples, magnets and paper rockets into physics she can touch.

titles.ja: イーロンと ふしぎな ぶつり
titles.zh: 埃隆和奇妙的物理

blurbs.fr: Olivia visite un atelier ensoleillé, où Elon transforme pommes, aimants et fusées de papier en physique à toucher.
blurbs.es: Olivia visita un taller soleado, donde Elon convierte manzanas, imanes y cohetes de papel en física que se puede tocar.
blurbs.ja: オリビアが工房をたずね、イーロンとりんごやロケットで物理を学びます。
blurbs.zh: 奥利维亚走进阳光工坊，埃隆用苹果、磁铁和纸火箭把物理变成可以触摸的故事。

books.title: Olivia and the Quiet Fire
books.subtitle: Heat is a tiny dance
books.blurb: Olivia holds a sun-warm stone and learns that heat is tiny bits dancing — faster when things feel warm.

titles.ja: オリビアと しずかな ひ
titles.zh: 奥利维亚和安静的火

blurbs.fr: Olivia tient une pierre chaude et apprend que la chaleur est une danse de tout petits morceaux.
blurbs.es: Olivia sostiene una piedra caliente y aprende que el calor es un baile de pedacitos.
blurbs.ja: オリビアはあたたかい石をもって、熱は小さな粒のおどりだと学びます。
blurbs.zh: 奥利维亚捧着一块被太阳晒热的石头，明白热是小微粒在跳舞。

books.title: Olivia and the Stubborn Cart
books.subtitle: Things keep doing what they were doing
books.blurb: Olivia pushes a little cart and learns that a force is a push or a pull — and that moving things want to keep moving.

titles.ja: オリビアと がんこな くるま
titles.zh: 奥利维亚和倍强的小车

blurbs.fr: Olivia pousse un petit chariot et apprend qu'une force est une poussée ou une traction.
blurbs.es: Olivia empuja un carrito y aprende que una fuerza es un empujón o un tirón.
blurbs.ja: オリビアは小さな車をおして、力は押すか引くことだと学びます。
blurbs.zh: 奥利维亚推着一辆小车，明白力就是推或拉，动着的东西还想继续动。

books.title: Olivia and the Floating Rock
books.subtitle: Water can hold you up
books.blurb: Olivia drops a pebble and a wooden boat, then learns that water hugs upward — and that is why some things float.

titles.es: Olivia y la piedra que flota
titles.ja: オリビアと うく いし
titles.zh: 奥利维亚和会漂的石头

blurbs.fr: Olivia laisse tomber un caillou et un bateau de bois, et apprend que l'eau pousse vers le haut.
blurbs.es: Olivia deja caer un guijarro y un barquito, y aprende que el agua empuja hacia arriba.
blurbs.ja: オリビアはいしと木の舟をうかべ、水が上へおし上げることを学びます。
blurbs.zh: 奥利维亚扔下石子和木船，明白水会向上抱住东西，所以有的会浮。

books.title: Olivia and the Invisible Ocean
books.subtitle: We live at the bottom of a sea of air
books.blurb: Olivia waves a paper fan and learns that air is real, has weight, and hugs everything — even a cup stuck to the table.

titles.ja: オリビアと みえない うみ
titles.zh: 奥利维亚和看不见的海

blurbs.fr: Olivia agite un éventail et apprend que l'air est réel, a un poids, et nous entoure comme un océan.
blurbs.es: Olivia agita un abanico y aprende que el aire es real, pesa, y nos rodea como un océano.
blurbs.ja: オリビアはうちわをふり、空気はほんとうにあり、重さがあると学びます。
blurbs.zh: 奥利维亚扇着纸扇，明白空气是真的，有重量，像海一样围着我们。

books.title: Olivia and the Three Faces of Water
books.subtitle: Ice, puddle, cloud — same stuff
books.blurb: Olivia watches an ice cube become a puddle, then a cloud on the window, and learns that water can wear three faces.

titles.fr: Olivia et les trois visages de l'eau
titles.es: Olivia y las tres caras del agua
titles.ja: オリビアと みずの みっつのかお
titles.zh: 奥利维亚和水的三张脸

blurbs.fr: Olivia voit un glaçon devenir flaque, puis nuage sur la vitre, et apprend que l'eau a trois visages.
blurbs.es: Olivia ve un cubito volverse charco y luego nube en el cristal, y aprende que el agua tiene tres caras.
blurbs.ja: オリビアは氷が水になり、窓でくもになるのを見て、水には三つの顔があると学びます。
blurbs.zh: 奥利维亚看着冰块变成水洼，又在窗上变成小雾，明白水可以有三张脸。

books.title: Olivia and the Sticky Floor
books.subtitle: Rough things hold on
books.blurb: Olivia slides on a smooth bench, then stops on a rough mat, and learns that friction is a quiet grab between things that touch.

titles.ja: オリビアと くっつく ゆか
titles.zh: 奥利维亚和黏黏的地板

blurbs.fr: Olivia glisse sur un banc lisse, s'arrête sur un tapis rêche, et apprend que le frottement est une petite prise invisible.
blurbs.es: Olivia resbala en un banco liso, se detiene en un tapete áspero, y aprende que la fricción es un agarre callado.
blurbs.ja: オリビアはなめらかな机ですべり、ざらざらのマットで止まり、まさつは静かなつかみだと学びます。
blurbs.zh: 奥利维亚在光滑的桌上滑过，又在粗糙的垫子上停下，明白摩擦力是东西互相抓住的安静的手。

books.title: Olivia and the Long Stick
books.subtitle: A stick can borrow strength
books.blurb: Olivia cannot lift a heavy lid — until Elon slides a long stick under it and shows her how a lever borrows strength.

titles.ja: オリビアと ながい ぼう
titles.zh: 奥利维亚和长棍子

blurbs.fr: Olivia n'arrive pas à soulever un couvercle lourd — jusqu'à ce qu'Elon glisse un long bâton dessous.
blurbs.es: Olivia no puede levantar una tapa pesada — hasta que Elon desliza un palo largo debajo.
blurbs.ja: オリビアはおもいふたを持ち上げられない。イーロンが長い棒をすべりこませます。
blurbs.zh: 奥利维亚抬不动沉重的盖子——直到埃隆把一根长棍子伸到下面。

books.title: Olivia and the Hidden Jump
books.subtitle: Energy can hide, then run
books.blurb: Olivia winds a little toy that sits still — then hops — and learns that energy can hide in a spring, a high-up ball, or a bite of lunch.

titles.ja: オリビアと かくれた ジャンプ
titles.zh: 奥利维亚和藏起来的一跳

blurbs.fr: Olivia remonte un petit jouet immobile — puis il saute — et apprend que l'énergie peut se cacher.
blurbs.es: Olivia da cuerda a un juguete quieto — luego salta — y aprende que la energía puede esconderse.
blurbs.ja: オリビアがぜんまいのおもちゃを巻くと、じっとしてから跳びます。エネルギーはかくれられるのです。
blurbs.zh: 奥利维亚给一个小玩具上发条，它先不动，再跳起来。她明白能量可以藏起来。

books.title: Olivia and the Wobbly Ruler
books.subtitle: Heavy middles stand tall
books.blurb: Olivia stands a ruler on its end, watches it tip, and learns that every thing has a quiet middle — and a wide base keeps that middle from falling over.

titles.fr: Olivia et la règle qui penche
titles.ja: オリビアと ぐらぐら じょうぎ
titles.zh: 奥利维亚和晃晃的尺子

blurbs.fr: Olivia dresse une règle sur sa tranche, la voit pencher, et apprend qu'une base large garde le milieu au-dessus.
blurbs.es: Olivia pone una regla de pie, la ve caer, y aprende que una base ancha guarda el medio encima.
blurbs.ja: オリビアがじょうぎを立てると倒れます。広い足もとは、まん中を支えつづけます。
blurbs.zh: 奥利维亚把尺子立起来，看着它倒下，明白宽底座能把重心留在上面。

books.title: Olivia and the Painted Sky
books.subtitle: Air is a quiet prism
books.blurb: Olivia wonders why the sky is blue and the sunset red, and learns that air spills the Sun's blue light all over the day.

titles.ja: オリビアと ぬられた そら
titles.zh: 奥利维亚和被涂过的天空

blurbs.fr: Olivia se demande pourquoi le ciel est bleu et le coucher de soleil rouge, et apprend que l'air répand la lumière bleue.
blurbs.es: Olivia se pregunta por qué el cielo es azul y el atardecer rojo, y aprende que el aire derrama la luz azul.
blurbs.ja: オリビアは空が青いわけ、夕やけが赤いわけを知り、空気が青い光をばらまくことを学びます。
blurbs.zh: 奥利维亚想知道天空为什么是蓝的、晚霞为什么是红的，明白空气把阳光里的蓝光洒了一整天。

books.title: Zero and Belle
books.subtitle: One rock, one romp
books.blurb: Zero is eight and loves rocks. Belle is eleven months and loves to play. Two German shepherd sisters, one candy toy, and a very important stone.

titles.ja: ゼロとベル
titles.zh: 零与贝儿

blurbs.fr: Zéro a huit ans et aime les cailloux. Belle a onze mois et aime jouer. Deux soeurs bergers allemands, un bonbon en peluche, et une pierre très importante.
blurbs.es: Zero tiene ocho años y ama las piedras. Belle tiene once meses y ama jugar. Dos hermanas pastor alemán, un caramelo de peluche y una piedra muy importante.
blurbs.ja: ゼロは8さいで石がすき。ベルは11か月で、あそぶのがだいすき。キャンディのぬいぐるみと、だいじな石。
blurbs.zh: 零八岁，爱石头。贝儿十一个月，爱玩。两只德牧姐妹，一只彩虹糖玩具，和一颗很重要的石头。

books.title: Olivia and the Two Sisters
books.subtitle: Zero is calm. Belle is bounce.
books.blurb: Olivia sits on the beige couch with Zero, who loves rocks, and Belle, who never sits still. Two German shepherd sisters. One girl. One home.

books.title: Olivia and the Lost Rock
books.subtitle: Sisters help find treasure.
books.blurb: Zero's favorite rock goes missing. Belle has an idea. Olivia leads the search across the patio, the garden, and the grass until the treasure comes home.

books.title: Olivia and the Yard Romp
books.subtitle: Red clay, two tails, one laugh.
books.blurb: Olivia bursts onto the red-clay yard with Belle racing ahead and Zero trotting behind. Patio chairs, a green shed, and woods full of wind.

books.title: Olivia and the Garden Beds
books.subtitle: Dirt under the fingernails.
books.blurb: Olivia waters the wooden raised beds beside the white house — lettuce, pots, a chicken coop, and a green can that makes the plants drink.

books.subtitle: The hill drinks light.
books.blurb: Olivia sits on the green hill and wonders why the dark panels shine gold. The quiet sun is working, even when nobody is looking.

books.title: Olivia and the House on the Hill
books.subtitle: Home is the white house.
books.blurb: Olivia walks the red clay in front of her long white house — dark metal roof, wooden deck, white pickup, woods all around — and learns the shape of home.

titles.es: Olivia and the House on the Hill

books.title: Olivia and the Porch That Wouldn't Stay Lit
books.subtitle: Some light is braver when it is shared.
books.blurb: On Halloween night the porch jack-o'-lanterns dim one by one. Olivia, Zero, and Belle keep watch and meet a shy wind that drinks flame because it is afraid of the dark.

books.title: Zero, Belle, and the Candy That Walked Away
books.subtitle: Some trails are a way of asking.
books.blurb: On Halloween dusk Olivia's candy vanishes, and a trail of foil leads into the woods. Belle wants the chase, Zero wants proof, and Olivia learns the trail was never a trap.

books.title: Olivia and the Midnight Library on the Hill
books.subtitle: The truest story is the strongest.
books.blurb: For one hour after midnight, the attic becomes a library of stories about Olivia's own life. One unfinished book begs for a thrilling, false ending. Olivia has to choose the true one.

books.title: Olivia and the Map Drawn in Chalk Dust
books.subtitle: Some stories wait years for an ending.
books.blurb: Chalk arrows appear overnight on the red clay drive, and they rearrange themselves when no one is looking. Olivia follows them to a thin place under the deck, where an old unfinished story is waiting.

books.title: Olivia and the Costume That Remembered Someone Else
books.subtitle: Everyone deserves one night of being someone.
books.blurb: Olivia's handmade fox costume fits perfectly, until she feels a second heartbeat inside it. The costume tugs her toward an old shop at the edge of town, where something has waited fifty years to go trick-or-treating.

books.title: Otto and the Shy Moon
books.subtitle: A bedtime pop-up story
books.blurb: Otto floats up on his red balloon to find the moon and bring her back.

titles.ja: オットと はずかしがりやの つき
titles.zh: 奥托和害羞的月亮

blurbs.fr: Otto s'élève avec son ballon rouge pour retrouver la lune et la ramener.
blurbs.es: Otto sube con su globo rojo para encontrar la luna y traerla de vuelta.
blurbs.ja: オットはあかい風船で月をさがし、つれて帰ります。
blurbs.zh: 奥托坐着红气球飞上去，找到害羞的月亮，再把她带回家。

books.title: Nia and the Runaway Kite
books.subtitle: A windy day story
books.blurb: Nia chases her kite over the river, up the hill and into the clouds.

titles.ja: ニアと にげた たこ
titles.zh: 妮娅和跑掉的风筝

blurbs.fr: Nia court après son cerf-volant, par-dessus la rivière, jusqu'aux nuages.
blurbs.es: Nia persigue su cometa sobre el río, por la colina y hasta las nubes.
blurbs.ja: ニアはたこを追って、川や山、雲のなかまでいきます。
blurbs.zh: 妮娅追着风筝过河、上山，一直跑进云朵里。

books.title: Fin and the Glowing Sea
books.subtitle: An underwater story
books.blurb: Fin dives deeper than ever to bring back the lantern fish's lost light.

titles.es: Fin y el mar que brilla
titles.ja: フィンと ひかる うみ
titles.zh: 芬和发光的海

blurbs.fr: Fin plonge plus profond que jamais pour ramener la lumière perdue du poisson-lanterne.
blurbs.es: Fin se sumerge más hondo que nunca para devolver la luz perdida del pez linterna.
blurbs.ja: フィンは深く潜って、ランタン魚の失った光をもどします。
blurbs.zh: 芬潜到更深的海底，把灯笼鱼丢掉的光带回来。
